_comment: Camera memory offsets template for ExternalMemoryDriver. Use Cheat Engine to find these per-game.
_howto: 1. Open Cheat Engine, attach to game process
2. Find camera X coordinate (float scan: changed/unchanged)
3. Y and Z are typically at +0x4 and +0x8 from X
4. Find pitch/yaw/roll similarly (rotate camera, scan for changed float)
5. FOV is usually near the rotation struct
7. Fill in the offsets below as hex strings
